name: Lista USD
oneLiner: lisUSD is Lista DAO's BNB Chain stablecoin; the CDP that mints it is winding down by 2026-10-31 as positions move to Lista Lending.
collateral: BNB, ETH, liquid-staking tokens, BTCB and additional issuer-listed GemJoin assets support CDPs. Issuer PSM documentation names USDT and USDC for nominal 1:1 minting; FDUSD is separately listed as CDP collateral. D3M is a distinct credit-based direct-deposit exposure.
pegMechanism: PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with centralized stablecoins; CDP overcollateralization and liquidation

notices.title: lisUSD CDP winding down: 31 October 2026
notices.message: Lista DAO is retiring the CDP that mints lisUSD; existing positions must migrate to Lista Lending or be repaid and withdrawn by 31 October 2026. New CDP borrowing already reverts protocol-wide, and lisUSD continues in Lista Lending and the PSM.
